# costory_billing_datasource_custom_bigquery (Resource)

Creates a Costory custom BigQuery billing datasource. See the full documentation [here](https://docs.costory.io/setup/billing#custom-bigquery).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    costory = {
      source  = "costory-io/costory"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "costory_api_token" {
  type        = string
  description = "Costory API token."
  sensitive   = true
}

provider "costory" {
  token = var.costory_api_token
}

resource "costory_billing_datasource_custom_bigquery" "main" {
  name          = "Custom BigQuery Billing"
  bq_table_path = "my-project.custom.costs"
  provider_name = "acme"

  mapping = {
    billed_cost  = "cost"
    service_name = "sku"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bq_table_path` (String) BigQuery table path (`project_id.dataset_id.table_name`).
- `mapping` (Attributes) Column mapping from the BigQuery table to Costory billing fields. `billed_cost` is required; other fields are optional BigQuery column names. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mapping))
- `name` (String) Billing datasource display name.
- `provider_name` (String) Provider name stored with the imported billing rows.

### Optional

- `billing_account_id` (String) Optional billing account identifier.
- `end_date` (String) Optional filter end date (ISO-8601).
- `start_date` (String) Optional filter start date (ISO-8601).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Billing datasource ID returned by Costory.
- `status` (String) Datasource status returned by Costory.
- `type` (String) Datasource type. Always `CustomBigQuery` for this resource.
